# laravelforge_forge_recipe (Data Source)

Fetches a single first-party Forge-provided recipe from the global catalog by ID. Read-only; distinct from an organization's own recipes.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the Forge recipe.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `info` (String) Recipe description / info.
- `name` (String) Recipe name.
- `script` (String) Shell script the recipe executes.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `user` (String) User the recipe runs as.
